description: This file implements a handler for accessing and querying the Android call log. It defines data structures for call log records and search requests, manages permissions, performs content resolution queries on the call log content provider, and provides a JSON-based interface for external calls.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a call log record, including number, cached name, date, duration, and type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating search parameters for filtering call logs.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checking and searching call logs.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Object implementing CallLogDataSource, accessing Android's CallLog content provider.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class managing call log queries, permission checks, and JSON interaction.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Public method to process a JSON request for searching call logs and return results or errors.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a CallLogSearchRequest object.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord object into a JSON representation.
